quote: yang ditetapkan Badan adalah 5,59% untuk Program
note: BPJS Ketenagakerjaan Integrated Report 2020. The most explicit text-layer passage for 5,59% (left column, read line by line): 'Secara umum hasil pengembangan DJS tahun 2020, masih lebih tinggi dibanding rata-rata suku bunga deposito counter rate bank pemerintah untuk jangka waktu satu tahun. Tingkat imbal hasil investasi terendah yang ditetapkan Badan adalah 5,59% untuk Program JHT, atau selisih 1,91% dari tingkat rata-rata bunga deposito counter rate bank pemerintah tahun 2020 sebesar 3,68%.' The quote is the part contiguous in the two-column layout text. The same page's table gives the JHT investment yield as 7,39%, so 5,59% is not the yield; reading it as the rate set for member balances is an inference (a CNBC reprint's 5,63% was rejected). The evidence for that reading is image only and not quote-checked: BPJS's one-page 2020 summary shows 5,59% against the 3,68% deposit counter rate in a panel titled 'PERBANDINGAN HASIL PENGEMBANGAN JHT DENGAN DEPOSITO BANK PEMERINTAH', legend 'Hasil pengembangan JHT'; the same panel in the 2016 summary carries 7,19% for 2016 and 6,89% for 2015, the 2016 base and 2015 year-end rates; the 2021 summary drops the panel and gives instead a JHT Yield of Investment (YOI) of 5,90%. In IR 2021 and IR 2025 similar wording names the lowest program yield in the table (JKP), while 5,59% matches no 2020 table value (the lowest is JP at 6,93%). No other stored text-layer document prints 5,59% for JHT. BPJS has published no credited rate for 2021 to 2025, so there are no base rows for those years.
